article.title: FocusFuel公布ZAYN合作，以巡演幕後概念設計聯乘套裝
article.summary: FocusFuel公布歌手ZAYN為投資者及合作夥伴，首個聯乘以巡演幕後為概念推出特別套裝。
highlights: 套裝包含士多啤梨檸檬及西瓜兩款口味。
品牌計劃加入幕後內容及紐約粉絲體驗。
article.why: 品牌可把藝人合作的故事轉為包裝和體驗設計，為不同接觸點設定可量度目標。
article.next_step: 為聯乘套裝、幕後內容和現場活動分別設定連結及追蹤指標。
article.detail: FocusFuel表示，與ZAYN的首個聯乘把巡演幕後靈感用於特別套裝，並安排幕後內容及紐約粉絲體驗。活動報道聚焦合作身分、套裝概念及推廣安排。品牌可參考這種做法，先定出粉絲從哪個渠道認識聯乘，再檢查內容互動、商品頁到訪及活動登記等不同環節。
article.title_en: FocusFuel announces ZAYN partnership with a backstage-inspired kit
article.summary_en: FocusFuel announced singer ZAYN as an investor and partner. Their first collaboration draws on backstage touring for a special kit.
highlights_en: The kit includes strawberry lemonade and watermelon flavours.
The brand plans behind-the-scenes content and a New York fan experience.
article.why_en: Brands can translate a partner story into packaging and experiences with measurable goals for each touchpoint.
article.next_step_en: Set distinct links and tracking measures for the kit, backstage content and live experience.
article.detail_en: FocusFuel says its first collaboration with ZAYN carries a touring backstage theme into a special kit. It also announced behind-the-scenes content and a planned New York fan experience. The case centers on the partnership, packaging and promotion. Teams can map where fans first encounter a collaboration and check content engagement, product-page visits and event registrations separately.
